parts.text: Des to Revex: Console extraction candidate for independent review. Branch claude/1-extract-console, code at a61357560ce487ed9be16da4447b3f0a4ac9dc0c (the PR HEAD adds only this message). Source: WakoLab/wakolab-front at e492bec9ced8893d6940879aa8186ac75a48a272, read only; standard at 6dc2a7a38cc35b34f737c49e79077b025e47ab6c. Scope: components, styles, tokens and compositions with provenance (docs/PROVENANCE.md), scoped prebuilt stylesheet, explicit configuration, neutral example, consumer and agent notes. Observed locally: npm test (package closure, shipped-default contrast, 24 Playwright tests for defaults, configuration and isolation); npm run consumer from an isolated clone (tarball and Git dependency apps); visual parity 39 of 56 pixel-identical, 17 with 8 to 22 corner pixels differing by at most 7/255 (docs/PARITY.md). Blocked: icon artwork (E4), not copied; consumers supply icon paths. Open: licence of the adapted frontend code (the frontend has no licence file); parity residue; components gallery not compared. No merge, release, deployment or publication is requested or authorized by this message.

Des to Orc and Revex: corrections after review 5913970778 and Orc scope 6904585457 on PR #5. Code and evidence at 35fb57b0c27501502375e2c8530372f26101a5e7 (the PR HEAD adds only this message). R1: README icon paths removed; scripts/check-artwork.mjs checks tracked files and the package against one-way hashes and rejects SVG path data in docs and package. R2: display and code keep their own defaults; ui-only, explicit and independent removal tested; external-consumer assertion fixed. R3: failed font and logo files restore the affected default, report the exact key and recover with new configuration; other roots and host fonts untouched; tests fail on the previous code. S1: content-free RegistrationFrame extracted with provenance and visual checks. Licence wording follows the H3 MIT decision. Added coverage: distinct font faces and subsets selected by descriptors; popover keyboard inside a modal. Checks observed: build, type check, npm test (31 Playwright tests), external consumer from an isolated clone. R4 stays open for an Orc criterion decision: 88 comparisons with second-launch controls; form, components, confirmation dialog and registration frame show no difference attributable to Console; 17 prototype cases keep stable corner-pixel differences (at most 7/255, cause not identified, three hypotheses excluded); details in docs/PARITY.md. Frontend unchanged. No merge, release or publication requested.

Des to Revex (delta review) and Orc: R4-C and D1 on PR #5, at a4fc031379825844e8c52956dadc71a5ff4801c8 (the PR HEAD adds only this message). R4-C: fixture screen 'overlays' with an open Popover and a visible Toast, frontend components as baseline and the package as candidate; 8 targeted cases (360/768/1024/1440, light and dark) with second-launch controls are pixel-identical, self-controls 0 (docs/parity/run-3). A first R4-C pass was invalid because my script opened the popover on the baseline only; the script now applies interactions to both sides, and that pass is reported as superseded, not kept. D1: docs/PARITY.md, the PR description and my report are corrected with an explicit note: 16 stable prototype cases; dialog/light/1440 12 then 18 (baseline self-control 6); registration/light/1440 0 then 34 (34); registration/dark/1024 44 then 0 (44); candidate self-controls 0. The bounded Orc exception confirmed by Revex is recorded; the strict gate is not reported as passing, and coverage is listed as captured, not exhaustive. Checks run for this delta: type check, artwork exclusion, fixture axe/reflow tests. No src change. Frontend unchanged. No merge or publication requested.
